synopsis: Chapter 3, Chapter 12 and the glossary place AI Act Annex I obligations for high-risk AI embedded in machinery at 2 August 2028; Chapter 12 separately dates Annex III obligations to 2 December 2027 [f2094, f9798, f12409, f9797]. The corpus contains an unresolved applicability tension: Chapter 3 says machinery products are removed from direct high-risk classification, and Chapter 12 cites summaries describing broad exemption, while Chapter 13 insists the deferral is not an exemption and qualifying embedded components will require conformity [f2095, f9799, f11223, f11224]. The machinery carve-out and delegated-act mechanism were not supported by the Official Journal text reviewed for Chapter 12, and the suggested interim use of harmonised AI Act standards for Machinery Regulation conformity rests on unverified August 2026 commentary [f9801, f7431]. Planning should therefore include applicability sign-off, regulatory dates, simulation acceptance and assessor engagement; the skeptical review specifically expects a notified-body or legal opinion on Machinery Regulation and AI Act applicability [f10165, f11134].
